044        public static float MAP_WIDTH_PADDING = 8000;
045        public static float MAP_HEIGHT_PADDING = 5000;
046        /**
047         * 21x11 characters
048         * Capital letter: endpoints
049         * Lowercase letter, optional: control point for 3-point stream (if 2: cubic bezier curve instead of quadratic)
050         * Direction of flow is determined by time of cycle and relative location of endpoints
051         * X is ignored; just marks the center to make it easier to edit
052         * After a capital letter:
053         * < makes the stream go in the opposite-to-standard direction
054         * +-<single digit number> adjusts the stream's burn level; 0 means +10
055         * ~ makes the stream narrower, on average
056         * = makes it wider
057         * | makes it much straighter than usual
058         * ! priority, spawned before other streams (and thus other streams will fade when intersecting it, not this one)
059         * ^ only keep longest segment - but, from intersections with streams ONLY, not with stars/other blockers
060         * * randomize: up to +10 burn, reverse, straightness, wide/narrow 
061         * ? randomize: same as above, but no reverse and only up to +5 burn
062         */
063        public static Map<String, Float> STREAM_CONFIGS = new LinkedHashMap<String, Float>();
064        
065        static {
066                loadConfigs();
067        }

217        public static void mirrorPrevVert(float weight) {
218                String prev = (String) STREAM_CONFIGS.keySet().toArray()[STREAM_CONFIGS.size() - 1];
219                STREAM_CONFIGS.put(mirrorVert(prev), weight);
220        }
221        public static String mirrorVert(String in) {
222                String out = "";
223                for (int j = 0; j < HEIGHT; j++) {
224                        out = in.substring(j * WIDTH, (j + 1) * WIDTH) + out;
225                }
226                return out;
227        }
228        public static void mirrorPrevHorz(float weight) {
229                String prev = (String) STREAM_CONFIGS.keySet().toArray()[STREAM_CONFIGS.size() - 1];
230                STREAM_CONFIGS.put(mirrorHorz(prev), weight);
231        }
232        public static String mirrorHorz(String in) {
233                String out = "";
234                for (int j = 0; j < HEIGHT; j++) {
235                        out = out + new StringBuilder(in.substring(j * WIDTH, (j + 1) * WIDTH)).reverse();
236                }
237                return out;
238        }
239        
240        public static void validateConfigs() {
241                // make sure they all parse
242                for (String key : STREAM_CONFIGS.keySet()) {
243                        if (key.length() != WIDTH * HEIGHT) {
244                                throw new RuntimeException("Length of slipstream config not WIDTHxHEIGHT [" + key + "]");
245                        }
246                        try {
247                                new StreamConfig(key, null);
248                        } catch (Throwable t) {
249                                throw new RuntimeException("Error parsing slipstream config [" + key + "]", t);
250                        }
251                }
252                
253        }

255        public static class StreamData {
256                public String id;
257                public int p0x = -1;
258                public int p0y = -1;
259                public int p1x = -1;
260                public int p1y = -1;
261                public int controlX = -1;
262                public int controlY = -1;
263                public int control2X = -1;
264                public int control2Y = -1;
265                public int burnMod = 0;
266                public boolean reverse = false;
267                public StreamType type = StreamType.NORMAL;
268                public boolean wasUsed = false;
269                public boolean straight = false;
270                public boolean priority = false;
271                public boolean onlyKeepLongestSegment = false;
272                public boolean randomize = false;
273                public boolean minorRandomize = false;
274                
275                public StreamData(String id) {
276                        this.id = id;
277                }
278                public Vector2f generateP0(Random random) {
279                        if (p0x < 0) return null;
280                        return generate(p0x, p0y, random);
281                }
282                public Vector2f generateP1(Random random) {
283                        if (p1x < 0) return null;
284                        return generate(p1x, p1y, random);
285                }
286                public Vector2f generateControl(Random random) {
287                        if (controlX < 0) return null;
288                        return generate(controlX, controlY, random);
289                }
290                public Vector2f generateControl2(Random random) {
291                        if (control2X < 0) return null;
292                        return generate(control2X, control2Y, random);
293                }
294                public Vector2f generate(int cellX, int cellY, Random random) {
295                        float sw = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorWidth") - MAP_WIDTH_PADDING;
296                        float sh = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorHeight") - MAP_HEIGHT_PADDING;
297                        float cellWidth = sw / WIDTH;
298                        float cellHeight = sh / HEIGHT;
299                        Vector2f p = new Vector2f();
300//                      if (cellX == 20) {
301//                              System.out.println("efwefwef");
302//                      }
303                        float minX = -sw/2f + cellWidth * cellX;
304                        float maxX = -sw/2f + cellWidth * (cellX + 1);
305                        float minY = -sh/2f + cellHeight * cellY;
306                        float maxY = -sh/2f + cellHeight * (cellY + 1);
307                        
308                        p.x = minX + (maxX - minX) * random.nextFloat();
309                        p.y = minY + (maxY - minY) * random.nextFloat();
310//                      p.x = minX + (maxX - minX) * 0f;
311//                      p.y = minY + (maxY - minY) * 0f;
312//                      p.x = minX + (maxX - minX) * 1f;
313//                      p.y = minY + (maxY - minY) * 1f;
314                        
315                        return p;
316                }
317        }

319        public static class StreamConfig {
320                
321                public List<StreamData> streams = new ArrayList<StreamData>();
322                public String data;
323                public StreamConfig(String data, Random random) {
324                        this.data = data;
325                        Set<String> ids = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
326                        for (int i = 0; i < data.length(); i++) {
327                                char c = data.charAt(i);
328                                if (c == 'X') continue;
329                                if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) {
330                                        ids.add("" + c);
331                                }
332                        }
333                        
334                        for (String id : ids) {
335                                StreamData curr = new StreamData(id);
336                                for (int i = 0; i < data.length(); i++) {
337                                        char c = data.charAt(i);
338                                        if (c == 'X') continue;
339                                        
340                                        int cellX = i % WIDTH;
341                                        int cellY = HEIGHT - i / WIDTH - 1;
342                                        if (id.equals("" + c)) {
343                                                if (curr.p0x < 0) {
344                                                        curr.p0x = cellX;
345                                                        curr.p0y = cellY;
346                                                } else if (curr.p1x < 0) {
347                                                        curr.p1x = cellX;
348                                                        curr.p1y = cellY;
349                                                }
350                                        } else if (id.toLowerCase().equals("" + c)) {
351                                                if (curr.controlX < 0) {
352                                                        curr.controlX = cellX;
353                                                        curr.controlY = cellY;
354                                                } else {
355                                                        curr.control2X = cellX;
356                                                        curr.control2Y = cellY;
357                                                }
358                                        }
359                                        
360                                        if (id.equals("" + c)) {
361                                                for (int j = i + 1; j < data.length() && j < i + 10; j++) {
362                                                        char c2 = data.charAt(j);
363                                                        if (c2 == ' ' || Character.isAlphabetic(c2)) break;
364                                                        if (c2 == '<') {
365                                                                curr.reverse = true;
366                                                        } else if (c2 == '~') {
367                                                                curr.type = StreamType.NARROW;
368                                                        } else if (c2 == '=') {
369                                                                curr.type = StreamType.WIDE;
370                                                        } else if (c2 == '-') {
371                                                                int burnMod = data.charAt(j + 1) - '0';
372                                                                if (burnMod == 0) burnMod = 10;
373                                                                curr.burnMod = -1 * burnMod;
374                                                        } else if (c2 == '+') {
375                                                                int burnMod = data.charAt(j + 1) - '0';
376                                                                if (burnMod == 0) burnMod = 10;
377                                                                curr.burnMod = burnMod;
378                                                        } else if (c2 == '|') {
379                                                                curr.straight = true;
380                                                        } else if (c2 == '!') {
381                                                                curr.priority = true;
382                                                        } else if (c2 == '^') {
383                                                                curr.onlyKeepLongestSegment = true;
384                                                        } else if (c2 == '*') {
385                                                                curr.randomize = true;
386                                                        } else if (c2 == '?') {
387                                                                curr.minorRandomize = true;
388                                                        }
389                                                }
390                                        }
391                                }
392                                if (curr.p0x >= 0 || curr.p1x >= 0) {
393                                        if ((curr.randomize || curr.minorRandomize) && random != null) {
394                                                if (!curr.reverse && !curr.minorRandomize) {
395                                                        curr.reverse = random.nextFloat() < 0.5f;
396                                                }
397                                                if (!curr.straight) {
398                                                        curr.straight = random.nextFloat() < 0.25f;
399                                                }
400                                                if (curr.burnMod == 0) {
401                                                        //curr.burnMod = (random.nextBoolean() ? 1 : -1) * random.nextInt(6);
402                                                        if (curr.minorRandomize) {
403                                                                curr.burnMod = random.nextInt(6);
404                                                        } else {
405                                                                curr.burnMod = random.nextInt(11);
406                                                        }
407                                                }
408                                                if (curr.type == StreamType.NORMAL) {
409                                                        float r = random.nextFloat();
410                                                        if (r < 0.2f) {
411                                                                curr.type = StreamType.NARROW;
412                                                        } else if (r < 0.4f) {
413                                                                curr.type = StreamType.WIDE;
414                                                        }
415                                                }
416                                        }
417                                        streams.add(curr);
418                                }
419                        }
420                }
421        }

425                public CampaignTerrainAPI terrain;

458        
459        public void advance(float amount) {
460                //if (true) return;
461                if (DebugFlags.SLIPSTREAM_DEBUG) {
462                        random = Misc.random;
463                }
464                
465//              int total = 0;
466//              for (AddedStream curr : active) {
467//                      total += curr.plugin.getSegments().size();
468//              }
469//              System.out.println("TOTAL SEGMENTS: " + total + ", streams: " + active.size());
470                
471                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
472                if (DebugFlags.SLIPSTREAM_DEBUG) {
473                        days *= 100f;
474                }
475                interval.advance(days);
476                //DebugFlags.SLIPSTREAM_DEBUG = true;
477                if (interval.intervalElapsed()) {
478                        Iterator<AddedStream> iter = active.iterator();
479                        while (iter.hasNext()) {
480                                AddedStream curr = iter.next();
481                                if (!curr.terrain.isAlive()) {
482                                        iter.remove();
483                                }
484                        }
485                        
486                        int month = Global.getSector().getClock().getMonth();
487                        int cycle = Global.getSector().getClock().getCycle();
488                        boolean isChangeMonth = month == 6 || month == 12;
489                        if (CHANGE_ONCE_PER_CYCLE) isChangeMonth = month == 12;
490                        
491                        if (isChangeMonth) {
492                                for (AddedStream curr : active) {
493                                        if (curr.plugin.isDespawning()) continue;
494                                        float despawnDelay = 0f + random.nextFloat() * 20f;
495                                        float timeMinusDelay = 27f - despawnDelay;
496                                        float despawnDays = timeMinusDelay * 0.5f + random.nextFloat() * timeMinusDelay * 0.5f;
497                                        curr.plugin.despawn(despawnDelay, despawnDays, random);
498                                }
499                                if (config != null) {
500                                        prevConfig = config.data;
501                                }
502                                config = null;
503                        } else if (!isChangeMonth) {
504                                if (config == null) {
505                                        if (DebugFlags.SLIPSTREAM_DEBUG) {
506                                                STREAM_CONFIGS.clear();
507                                                loadConfigs();
508                                        }
509                                        
510                                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
511                                        for (String key : STREAM_CONFIGS.keySet()) {
512                                                if (prevConfig != null && prevConfig.equals(key) && STREAM_CONFIGS.size() > 1) {
513                                                        continue;
514                                                }
515                                                picker.add(key, STREAM_CONFIGS.get(key));
516                                        }
517                                        if (picker.isEmpty() && prevConfig != null) {
518                                                picker.add(prevConfig, 1f);
519                                        }
520                                        ListenerUtil.updateSlipstreamConfig(prevConfig, picker, this);
521                                        String data = picker.pick();
522                                        if (data != null) {
523                                                config = new StreamConfig(data, random);
524                                        }
525                                }
526                                addStream(month, cycle);
527                        }
528                        
529                        
530                        prevMonth = month;
531                }
532                grid = null;
533        }
534        
535        
536        public void addStream(int month, int cycle) {
537                if (config == null) return;
538                
539                //random = new Random();
540//              long seed = 23895464576452L + 4384357483229348234L + 4343253L;
541//              seed = 1181783497276652981L ^ seed;
542//              Random random = new Random(seed);
543                
544                WeightedRandomPicker<StreamData> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<StreamData>(random);
545                for (StreamData data : config.streams) {
546                        if (data.wasUsed) continue;
547                        if (!data.priority) continue;
548                        picker.add(data);
549                }
550                if (picker.isEmpty()) {
551                        // add non-priority if all priority ones are already used
552                        for (StreamData data : config.streams) {
553                                if (data.wasUsed) continue;
554                                picker.add(data);
555                        }
556                }
557                
558                StreamData data = picker.pick();
559                if (data == null) return;
560                
561                SlipstreamParams2 params = new SlipstreamParams2();
562                params.burnLevel = 30 + data.burnMod;
563                params.minSpeed = Misc.getSpeedForBurnLevel(params.burnLevel - 5);
564                params.maxSpeed = Misc.getSpeedForBurnLevel(params.burnLevel + 5);
565                params.lineLengthFractionOfSpeed = 0.25f * Math.max(0.25f, Math.min(1f, 30f / (float) params.burnLevel));
566                
567                
568                Vector2f from = data.generateP0(random);
569                Vector2f to = data.generateP1(random);
570                Vector2f control = data.generateControl(random);
571                Vector2f control2 = data.generateControl2(random);
572                if (from == null || to == null) return;
573
574                // default direction is east in first half of the cycle, west in the second half
575                // months 6 and 12 don't really matter since the slipstreams despawn during those
576                
577                boolean earlyCycle = month == 12 || month < 6;
578                if (CHANGE_ONCE_PER_CYCLE) {
579                        earlyCycle = (month == 12 && cycle % 2 == 0) || (month != 12 && cycle % 2 == 1);
580                }
581                
582                if (earlyCycle) {
583                        if ((!data.reverse && from.x > to.x) || (data.reverse && from.x < to.x)) {
584                                Vector2f temp = to;
585                                to = from;
586                                from = temp;
587                        }
588                } else {
589                        if ((!data.reverse && from.x < to.x) || (data.reverse && from.x > to.x)) {
590                                Vector2f temp = to;
591                                to = from;
592                                from = temp;
593                        }
594                }
595                
596                
597                LocationAPI hyperspace = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
598                CampaignTerrainAPI slipstream = (CampaignTerrainAPI) hyperspace.addTerrain(Terrain.SLIPSTREAM, params);
599                
600                slipstream.setLocation(from.x, from.y);
601                SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 plugin = (SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) slipstream.getPlugin();
602                SlipstreamBuilder builder = new SlipstreamBuilder(slipstream.getLocation(), plugin, data.type, random);
603                
604                if (data.straight) {
605                        float mult = 0.25f;
606                        builder.setMaxAngleVariance(builder.getMaxAngleVariance() * mult);
607                        builder.setMaxAngleVarianceForCurve(builder.getMaxAngleVarianceForCurve() * mult);
608                }
609                
610                if (control2 != null) {
611                        float dist1 = Misc.getDistance(from, control);
612                        float dist2 = Misc.getDistance(from, control2);
613                        if (dist2 < dist1) {
614                                Vector2f temp = control2;
615                                control2 = control;
616                                control = temp;
617                        }
618                        builder.buildToDestination(control, control2, to);
619                } else if (control != null) {
620                        builder.buildToDestination(control, to);
621                } else {
622                        builder.buildToDestination(to);
623                }
624                
625                checkIntersectionsAndFadeSections(plugin, data.onlyKeepLongestSegment);
626                
627                if (plugin.getSegments().size() < 3) {
628                        hyperspace.removeEntity(slipstream);
629                        return;
630                }
631                
632                float spawnDays = 1f + 2f * random.nextFloat();
633                if (DebugFlags.SLIPSTREAM_DEBUG) {
634                        spawnDays = 0f;
635                }
636                plugin.spawn(spawnDays, random);
637                
638                plugin.recomputeEncounterPoints();
639                
640                AddedStream added = new AddedStream(plugin);
641                active.add(added);
642                data.wasUsed = true;
643        }

645        public void checkIntersectionsAndFadeSections(SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 plugin, boolean onlyKeepLongestBetweenStreams) {
646                updateGrid();
647                
648                plugin.recomputeIfNeeded();
649                
650                List<SlipstreamSegment> segments = plugin.getSegments();
651                
652                Set<SlipstreamSegment> otherStreamCuts = new HashSet<SlipstreamSegment>();
653                
654                for (SlipstreamSegment curr : segments) {
655                        
656                        Iterator<Object> iter = grid.getCheckIterator(curr.loc, curr.width / 2f, curr.width / 2f);
657                        while (iter.hasNext()) {
658                                Object obj = iter.next();
659                                if (obj instanceof JumpPointAPI) {
660                                        JumpPointAPI jp = (JumpPointAPI) obj;
661                                        Vector2f loc = jp.getLocation();
662                                        float radius = jp.getRadius();
663                                        if (jp.getOrbitFocus() != null) {
664                                                loc = jp.getOrbitFocus().getLocation();
665                                                radius = Misc.getDistance(jp.getOrbitFocus(), jp) + jp.getRadius();
666                                        }
667                                        
668                                        Vector2f diff = Vector2f.sub(loc, curr.loc, new Vector2f());
669                                        
670                                        float distPerp = Math.abs(Vector2f.dot(curr.normal, diff));
671                                        float distAlong = Math.abs(Vector2f.dot(curr.dir, diff));
672                                        
673                                        distPerp -= radius;
674                                        distAlong -= radius;
675                                        
676                                        float minDistAlong = Math.max(curr.lengthToNext, curr.lengthToPrev);
677                                        float fadeDistAlong = 500f + minDistAlong;
678                                        if (distPerp < curr.width / 2f && 
679                                                        distAlong < fadeDistAlong) {
680                                                if (distAlong < minDistAlong) {
681                                                        curr.fader.forceOut();
682                                                        curr.bMult = 0f;
683                                                } else {
684                                                        curr.bMult = Math.min(curr.bMult, 
685                                                                                                 (distAlong - minDistAlong) / (fadeDistAlong - minDistAlong));
686                                                }
687                                        }
688                                } else if (obj instanceof CampaignTerrainAPI) {
689                                        CampaignTerrainAPI terrain = (CampaignTerrainAPI) obj;
690                                        SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 otherPlugin = (SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) terrain.getPlugin();
691                                        if (otherPlugin == plugin) continue;
692                                        
693                                        for (SlipstreamSegment other : otherPlugin.getSegmentsNear(curr.loc, curr.width / 2f)) {
694                                                //if (other.fader.getBrightness() == 0 || other.bMult <= 0) continue;
695                                                if (other.bMult <= 0) continue;
696                                                
697                                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(curr.loc, other.loc);
698                                                float minDist = curr.width / 2f + other.width / 2f;
699                                                float fadeDist = minDist + 500f;
700                                                if (dist < fadeDist) {
701                                                        if (dist < minDist) {
702                                                                curr.fader.forceOut();
703                                                                curr.bMult = 0f;
704                                                                otherStreamCuts.add(curr);
705                                                        } else {
706                                                                curr.bMult = Math.min(curr.bMult, 
707                                                                                                         (dist - minDist) / (fadeDist - minDist));
708                                                        }
709                                                }
710                                        }
711                                } else if (obj instanceof CustomStreamBlocker) {
712                                        CustomStreamBlocker blocker = (CustomStreamBlocker) obj;
713                                        Vector2f loc = blocker.loc;
714                                        float radius = blocker.radius;
715                                        
716                                        Vector2f diff = Vector2f.sub(loc, curr.loc, new Vector2f());
717                                        float distPerp = Math.abs(Vector2f.dot(curr.normal, diff));
718                                        float distAlong = Math.abs(Vector2f.dot(curr.dir, diff));
719                                        
720                                        distPerp -= radius;
721                                        distAlong -= radius;
722                                        
723                                        float minDistAlong = Math.max(curr.lengthToNext, curr.lengthToPrev);
724                                        float fadeDistAlong = 500f + minDistAlong;
725                                        if (distPerp < curr.width / 2f && 
726                                                        distAlong < fadeDistAlong) {
727                                                if (distAlong < minDistAlong) {
728                                                        curr.fader.forceOut();
729                                                        curr.bMult = 0f;
730                                                } else {
731                                                        curr.bMult = Math.min(curr.bMult, 
732                                                                                                 (distAlong - minDistAlong) / (fadeDistAlong - minDistAlong));
733                                                }
734                                        }
735                                } else if (obj instanceof AbyssStreamBlocker) {
736                                        AbyssStreamBlocker abyss = (AbyssStreamBlocker) obj;
737                                        if (abyss.containsPoint(curr.loc)) {
738                                                curr.fader.forceOut();
739                                                curr.bMult = 0f;
740                                        }
741                                }
742                        }
743                }
744
745                fadeOutSectionsShorterThan(segments, 5000f);
746                
747                // unrelated to the above - for proximity-to-something fades that
748                // were unnecessary because there wasn't an actual intersection with that something
749                removedFadesThatDoNotReachZero(segments);
750                
751                
752                
753                if (onlyKeepLongestBetweenStreams) {
754                        List<SlipstreamSegment> longest = new ArrayList<SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2.SlipstreamSegment>();
755                        
756                        List<SlipstreamSegment> currList = new ArrayList<SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2.SlipstreamSegment>();
757                        
758                        for (SlipstreamSegment curr : segments) {
759                                if (otherStreamCuts.contains(curr)) {
760                                        if (currList.size() > longest.size()) {
761                                                longest = currList;
762                                        }
763                                        currList = new ArrayList<SlipstreamSegment>();
764                                }
765                                if (curr.bMult > 0f) {
766                                        currList.add(curr);
767                                }
768                        }
769                        if (currList.size() > longest.size()) {
770                                longest = currList;
771                        }
772                        for (SlipstreamSegment curr : segments) {
773                                if (!longest.contains(curr)) {
774                                        curr.bMult = 0f;
775                                        curr.fader.forceOut();
776                                }
777                        }
778                        
779                }
780        }
781        
782        
783        public static void fadeOutSectionsShorterThan(List<SlipstreamSegment> segments, float minLength) {
784                float minRunLength = minLength;
785                List<SlipstreamSegment> currRun = new ArrayList<SlipstreamSegment>();
786                for (SlipstreamSegment curr : segments) {
787                        if (curr.bMult <= 0f) {
788                                float runLength = 0f;
789                                for (SlipstreamSegment inRun : currRun) {
790                                        runLength += inRun.lengthToNext; // counts one more than it should; meh 
791                                }
792                                if (runLength < minRunLength) {
793                                        for (SlipstreamSegment inRun : currRun) {
794                                                inRun.fader.forceOut();
795                                                inRun.bMult = 0f;
796                                        }
797                                }
798                                currRun.clear();
799                        } else {
800                                currRun.add(curr);
801                        }
802                }
803        }
804        
805        public static void removedFadesThatDoNotReachZero(List<SlipstreamSegment> segments) {
806                List<SlipstreamSegment> currRun = new ArrayList<SlipstreamSegment>();
807                boolean currRunReachedZero = false;
808                for (SlipstreamSegment curr : segments) {
809                        if (curr.bMult < 1f) {
810                                currRun.add(curr);
811                                if (curr.bMult <= 0f || (curr.fader.getBrightness() == 0 && !curr.fader.isFadingIn())) {
812                                        currRunReachedZero = true;
813                                }
814                        } else {
815                                if (!currRunReachedZero) {
816                                        for (SlipstreamSegment inRun : currRun) {
817                                                inRun.fader.fadeIn();
818                                                inRun.bMult = 1f;
819                                        }
820                                }
821                                currRun.clear();
822                                currRunReachedZero = false;
823                        } 
824                }
825        }

861        public void updateGrid() {
862                if (grid != null) return;
863                
864                float sw = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorWidth");
865                float sh = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorHeight");
866                float minCellSize = 12000f;
867                float cellSize = Math.max(minCellSize, sw * 0.05f);
868                
869                grid = new CollisionGridUtil(-sw/2f, sw/2f, -sh/2f, sh/2f, cellSize);
870                
871                LocationAPI hyperspace = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
872                for (SectorEntityToken jp : hyperspace.getJumpPoints()) {
873                        float size = jp.getRadius() * 2f + 100f;
874                        grid.addObject(jp, jp.getLocation(), size * 2f, size * 2f);
875                }
876                
877//              for (NascentGravityWellAPI well : hyperspace.getGravityWells()) {
878//                      float size = 1000f + well.getRadius();
879//                      CustomStreamBlocker blocker = new CustomStreamBlocker(well.getLocation(), size);
880//                      grid.addObject(blocker, well.getLocation(), size * 2f, size * 2f);
881//              }
882                Object alphaSiteWell = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(TTBlackSite.NASCENT_WELL_KEY);
883                if (alphaSiteWell instanceof NascentGravityWellAPI) {
884                        NascentGravityWellAPI well = (NascentGravityWellAPI) alphaSiteWell;
885                        float size = 1000f + well.getRadius();
886                        CustomStreamBlocker blocker = new CustomStreamBlocker(well.getLocation(), size);
887                        grid.addObject(blocker, well.getLocation(), size * 2f, size * 2f);
888                }
889                
890                for (StarSystemAPI system : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
891                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE)) {
892                                Vector2f loc = system.getLocation();
893                                float size = 4000f;
894                                CustomStreamBlocker blocker = new CustomStreamBlocker(loc, size);
895                                grid.addObject(blocker, loc, size * 2f, size * 2f);
896                        }
897                }
898                
899                {
900                        float w = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorWidth");
901                        float h = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorHeight");
902//                      Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(-w/2f, -h/2f);
903//                      float size = 26000;
904//                      CustomStreamBlocker orionPersusAbyssBlocker = new CustomStreamBlocker(loc, size);
905//                      grid.addObject(orionPersusAbyssBlocker, loc, size * 2f, size * 2f);
906                        AbyssStreamBlocker orionPersusAbyssBlocker = new AbyssStreamBlocker();
907                        grid.addObject(orionPersusAbyssBlocker, new Vector2f(), w, h);
908                }
909                
910//              for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
911//                      if (market.isHidden()) continue;
912//                      //if (market.hasIndustry(Industries.SPACEPORT)) continue;
913//                      Industry spaceport = market.getIndustry(Industries.SPACEPORT);
914//                      if (spaceport == null || !spaceport.isFunctional()) continue;
915//                      
916//                      Vector2f loc = market.getLocationInHyperspace();
917//                      float size = 5000f;
918//                      CustomStreamRevealer revealer = new CustomStreamRevealer(loc, size);
919//                      grid.addObject(revealer, loc, size * 2f, size * 2f);
920//              }
921                
922                
923                int segmentsToSkip = (int) ((cellSize - 2000) / 400f);
924                float checkSize = minCellSize - 2000f;
925                
926                for (CampaignTerrainAPI curr : hyperspace.getTerrainCopy()) {
927                        if (curr.getPlugin() instanceof SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) {
928                                SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 plugin = (SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) curr.getPlugin();
929                                List<SlipstreamSegment> segments = plugin.getSegments();
930                                List<SlipstreamSegment> check = new ArrayList<SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2.SlipstreamSegment>();
931                                for (int i = 0; i < segments.size(); i += segmentsToSkip) {
932                                        check.add(segments.get(i));
933                                }
934                                if (!check.contains(segments.get(segments.size() - 1))) {
935                                        check.add(segments.get(segments.size() - 1));
936                                }
937                                
938                                for (SlipstreamSegment seg : check) {
939                                        grid.addObject(curr, seg.loc, checkSize, checkSize);
940                                }
941                        }
942                }
943                
944                ListenerUtil.updateSlipstreamBlockers(grid, this);
945        }
